name: SpecTool
description: A benchmark designed to identify and characterize error patterns in Large Language Models' outputs on tool-use tasks, providing insights beyond simple success rates to guide error mitigation strategies.
reputation: A niche benchmark for analyzing LLM tool-use errors that is useful for diagnostics, but not yet a widely standardized community leaderboard.
notes: Focuses on identifying seven newly characterized error patterns in LLM tool-use outputs.
